answer: The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in grove, expire in violet, and crystal lists each expiry. An copycat running 191 aliases as a result needs 52 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2043 identities would post 1497 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
